name: MieTrak Tools
description: A library of small MieTrak helpers behind a picker. Starts with the Hardware Code Generator.
author: Anthony Sieben

how_it_works: Pick a tool from the left list; its form shows on the right.

Hardware Code Generator: choose the system (imperial or metric), the material and coating, and the hardware type. The rows you still need appear: thread size for screws, studs and nuts; length for screws and studs; screw size for washers.
The part number builds itself as you pick. Press Copy Code to put it on the clipboard, then paste it into MieTrak.
output: The MieTrak hardware code on screen and on the clipboard - nothing is saved to a file.
